Rationale: Weather, season, hot/cold contrast, drink-temperature and ice-cream contexts clearly support the temperature sense; preserve the established cold#temperature identity.
Atishoo/Bless-you and headache/fever/cough/medicine contexts clearly support the illness noun; preserve the established cold#illness identity.
These remaining flat or mixed neighborhoods do not safely distinguish temperature from illness; keep them explicitly deferred rather than infer from the broad dictionary gloss.
Building, centre, exit and movement contexts support the elementary enter/go-in sense; computer-key and competition dictionary senses are excluded.
Engineer, plane and spaceship context supports design as planning or creating how something should be made; decorative-pattern dictionary senses are not added.
